actions.action: Store scope separately from claim wording
actions.mechanism: Population, setting, period, and outcome fields distinguish similar claims without treating different scopes as direct contradictions.
actions.implementation: Add passage-linked scope fields to each claim. Mark unstated dimensions unspecified; require confirmation before merging claims with different scope values.
actions.check: Load opposing findings about adults and adolescents. Verify separate claims, exact passage IDs, and visible population differences.
actions.risk: Inferred scope could misrepresent passages; preserve unspecified values.

actions.mechanism: Explicit evidence relationships prevent empty searches or absent links from becoming negative findings.
actions.implementation: Label claim–passage links supports, opposes, or contextualizes, with passage IDs and user confirmation. Display absent supporting links as missing supplied evidence.
actions.check: Remove supporting links and verify no opposition appears. An opposing relationship must retain an inspectable passage explicitly supporting that interpretation.
actions.risk: Automated relationship suggestions may mistake qualifications for opposition.

actions.action: Show disagreement before the polished summary
actions.mechanism: A paired evidence view exposes opposing findings while distinguishing scope differences and unresolved scope overlap.
actions.implementation: Place passage-linked finding cards side by side. Show population and other scope differences; label direct contradiction only after confirming comparable scope.
actions.check: Opposing adult and adolescent findings appear together as differently scoped, not as a resolved consensus or direct contradiction.
actions.risk: Pairing findings can imply comparability unless scope differences remain prominent.

actions.action: Require statement-level evidence before briefing export
actions.mechanism: A provenance gate binds every briefing claim and its scope to exact stored passages.
actions.implementation: Store passage IDs on each factual clause. Restrict summarization inputs to selected stored passages; block export for missing IDs and require scope confirmation.
actions.check: Reject a nonexistent ID and an uncited clause. An adult-only passage must not pass review for an all-populations statement.
actions.risk: Valid IDs establish traceability, not entailment; reviewers must inspect wording.

actions.action: Inspect original passages beside briefing text
actions.mechanism: An in-workspace source drawer lets users verify wording without abandoning their drafting context.
actions.implementation: Make every claim citation open the exact stored passage, its ID, and report metadata. Highlight cited spans without replacing the original passage text.
actions.check: Open citations from both opposing claims. Verify the correct originals remain readable alongside the draft without external navigation.
actions.risk: Highlights can distract from qualifications; always display the complete stored passage.

actions.action: Compress wording without silently dropping disagreement
actions.mechanism: An evidence-coverage ledger makes brevity tradeoffs explicit rather than allowing a summary to erase opposing findings.
actions.implementation: Map selected findings to briefing clauses. Before export, flag omitted opposing findings; require inclusion or explicit scope narrowing with a passage-backed limitation.
actions.check: Under a short word limit, opposing population-specific findings remain identifiable, or the briefing visibly narrows its population instead of implying consensus.
actions.risk: Coverage requirements may consume space; remove redundant prose before evidential distinctions.

actions.action: Invalidate briefing review when evidence changes
actions.mechanism: Dependency tracking prevents previously checked prose from silently surviving changes to its supporting claims or passages.
actions.implementation: Version stored passages and claim scopes. Track dependent briefing clauses; mark them for re-review after edits and block export when cited passages become unavailable.
actions.check: Change one population field and withdraw one cited passage. Verify dependent clauses require review without converting withdrawn support into opposing evidence.
actions.risk: Broad invalidation creates review fatigue; track dependencies at clause level.
